title: "I was charged the wrong amount"
story: Asha tells her bank FreshMart charged her more than she agreed to for her INR 1,250 weekly basket. The Guard compares the amount taken with the amount it allowed and with the cart's Quoted total. All three are INR 1,250, so the evidence is strong.

steps.instruction: Order this week's groceries: milk, eggs, bread and fruit, around 1,250 rupees.
steps.item: Weekly groceries: milk, eggs, bread, fruit

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Order this week's groceries, please: milk, eggs, bread and fruit, around 1,250 rupees.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: This week's basket at FreshMart is INR 1,250. Getting the cart checked.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: This week's basket at FreshMart comes to INR 1,250. Checking with AgentPay Guard before I pay.

what_to_notice: The pack proves the amount from records, not memory: the captured amount equals the Decision's amount, and neither is above the Quoted total the cart check saw. Filed under Visa 12.5 and Mastercard 4834, the incorrect-amount codes.
